trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate interior pixel angle of 48 degrees; depth is roughly 1/6th of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitude along the entire trailing edge; frequency of peaks increases towards the distal tips of both lobes, particularly visible on the camera-left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a strong convex curvature (sweep) along the trailing edges tapering to acute distal points; leading edges are partially submerged but indicate a slightly concave trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixel groupings (barnacles) are localized on the distal tip and along the upper trailing margin of the camera-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization (sessile cirripedes) visible as white calcified clusters on the trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
